comment.body: Thanks for checking the registry, the direct executable, and both Explorer menus. Your final clarification establishes that the legacy Explorer Edit command opens the same older Notepad; the modern menu uses a different editor entry. Current Hosts File Editor also explicitly launches system Notepad for the extensionless hosts file. This explains the observed selection, rather than demonstrating that opening the hosts file is failing. Maintainers can decide whether preferring the packaged Notepad application should be tracked as a separate compatibility enhancement; the supplied tests do not establish a Windows update defect or a shipped fix.
